name: Kelly Kaoudis
biography: Kelly Kaoudis is a senior software engineer working in application security in Colorado. Following working with the group to validate and test the node-netmask bypass Viale discovered, Kaoudis wrote many of the proofs-of-concept which demonstrate the critical impact of this cascade of unique vulnerabilities.
